items.t: eltwise/binary_ng: program-cache key incorrectly omits Alignment and Tile

ttnn.add/subtract/multiply silently return wrong values at rank >= 7 when an operand is broadcast at dim -6: binary_ng collapses dims -6 and outward into one counter, and four of six tiles read past the end of the operand
pow / maximum / minimum / gcd / lcm / bias_gelu silently ignore dtype=: nine signatures comment the parameter out and pass std::nullopt, while add/subtract/multiply honour it
global_avg_pool2d silently ignores dtype=, including the supported bfloat8_b, while the ordinary avg_pool2d path TT_FATALs on the same argument
ttnn.div silently ignores dtype=: every dispatch passes std::nullopt in the output-dtype slot, including the branch that just validated it
ttnn.unary_chain silently drops every op after the first when the head op uses a specialised kernel — hardswish→square returns unsquared hardswish
Quasar: two DFBs chained through a Tensix stage silently return wrong data when a DM endpoint outnumbers the Tensix side
conv1d/conv2d silently ignore conv_config.activation on the 1D-depthwise path: is_1d_depthwise_conv excludes has_bias but not activation, and the depthwise kernel cannot apply one
[LLK][BH] p_unpacr_nop defines three Wormhole-packed constants that silently mis-encode on Blackhole
matmul(activation="exp"/"log"/"log2"/"log10"/"log1p") silently selects the approximate kernel while ttnn.exp defaults to accurate — and no string spelling reaches the accurate one
avg_pool2d global fast path: padded ROW_MAJOR input is silently wrong for specific shapes
ttnn.bias_gelu silently computes the approximate GELU while ttnn.gelu defaults to exact
